Hi Sam — appreciate the heads-up and the runbook. Good news: we can provision a temporary uplift. Two quick commercial options to speed this:

1) Escrow credit path (fastest): ClearCart pre-funds an escrow (we recommend a $8k–$12k band depending on expected volume). We apply escrow credit to any overrun incurred during the uplift window; remaining balance refunded within 7 business days of reconciliation. We can offer a 20% discounted overrun rate off standard per-token/overrun pricing if escrow is funded before cutover.

2) PO + fixed uplift: ClearCart issues a PO and we run a time-limited uplift priced as a blended overage rate. If the PO is issued with payment terms (Net 30), we can extend a 15% discount on the uplift component.

Operational notes: we will gate uplift behind an autoscaling policy with a hard throttle to prevent runaway invoices. We will also enable prefix caching for repeated prompts to reduce token usage where possible.

Next steps: Laura, can you confirm whether Launchly wants the escrow route or PO? Ben / Irene, please weigh in on discount ceilings and any addendum. Sam / Procurement — if escrow, we'll send wiring instructions and a short escrow addendum; if PO, send PO + billing contact and we'll issue an addendum for signatures.

Cheers,
Markus Klein
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
